title.en: NVIDIA open-sources OSMO for physical-AI workflow orchestration
title.zhHans: NVIDIA 开源用于物理 AI 工作流编排的 OSMO

searchSummary.en: NVIDIA presented OSMO as an Apache-2.0, Kubernetes-native orchestrator that runs physical-AI workflows across training clusters, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop environments from YAML.
searchSummary.zhHans: NVIDIA 发布 OSMO，将其定位为 Apache-2.0 许可、Kubernetes 原生的物理 AI 编排器，可用 YAML 跨训练集群、仿真和硬件在环环境运行工作流。

summary.en: On September 14, NVIDIA publicly presented OSMO as an open-source physical-AI workflow orchestrator. Its developer page and repository describe YAML-defined workflows across training, simulation, evaluation, and hardware-in-the-loop tasks on heterogeneous Kubernetes clusters and edge devices. The repository uses an Apache-2.0 license. NVIDIA's FAQ says OSMO orchestrates these components but does not itself deploy models to production robots.
summary.zhHans: 9 月 14 日，NVIDIA 公开发布 OSMO，将其定位为开源物理 AI 工作流编排器。开发者页面和代码仓库描述了在异构 Kubernetes 集群及边缘设备上，用 YAML 定义跨训练、仿真、评估和硬件在环任务的工作流。该仓库采用 Apache-2.0 许可证。NVIDIA FAQ 说明，OSMO 负责编排这些组件，但本身不将模型部署到生产机器人。

narrative.en: OSMO addresses the handoffs among data-center training, workstation simulation, and edge or hardware-in-the-loop testing. The official materials describe dataset lineage, dependency management, resource scheduling, agent-aware CLI context, and cloud or on-premises deployment. The GitHub repository documents local and cloud deployment paths and the Apache-2.0 license. NVIDIA's production-scale and GPU-hours language remains a company claim, while the open-source release and documented workflow scope are directly observable. OSMO is an orchestrator, not a replacement for simulators, training frameworks, or robot deployment runtimes.
narrative.zhHans: OSMO 处理数据中心训练、工作站仿真以及边缘或硬件在环测试之间的衔接。官方材料描述了数据集溯源、依赖管理、资源调度、面向智能体的 CLI 上下文以及云端或本地部署。GitHub 仓库记录了本地和云部署路径，并标明 Apache-2.0 许可证。NVIDIA 关于生产规模和 GPU 小时数的表述仍是公司主张；开源发布和文档化工作流范围则可直接核验。OSMO 是编排器，不是仿真器、训练框架或机器人部署运行时的替代品。

description.en: Provides a single documented workflow layer for moving physical-AI jobs across training, simulation, evaluation, and hardware-in-the-loop environments.
description.zhHans: 提供单一且有文档支持的工作流层，将物理 AI 任务连接到训练、仿真、评估和硬件在环环境。

description.en: Uses YAML workflows, local quickstarts, and portable Kubernetes backends to reduce the infrastructure-specific scripting required for physical-AI experimentation.
description.zhHans: 通过 YAML 工作流、本地快速入门和可移植的 Kubernetes 后端，减少物理 AI 实验所需的基础设施专用脚本。

text.en: NVIDIA released OSMO as an open-source, Kubernetes-native physical-AI workflow orchestrator with an Apache-2.0 repository license.
text.zhHans: NVIDIA 发布 OSMO，将其作为开源、Kubernetes 原生的物理 AI 工作流编排器；代码仓库采用 Apache-2.0 许可证。

text.en: OSMO's documented workflows span data generation, training, simulation, evaluation, and hardware-in-the-loop testing across heterogeneous compute.
text.zhHans: OSMO 的文档化工作流覆盖异构计算环境中的数据生成、训练、仿真、评估和硬件在环测试。

text.en: OSMO orchestrates existing tools and prepares artifacts; NVIDIA says it does not itself deploy models to production robots or replace simulators and training frameworks.
text.zhHans: OSMO 编排现有工具并准备产物；NVIDIA 说明它本身不会将模型部署到生产机器人，也不替代仿真器和训练框架。

editorial.reviewNotes: L1 open-source infrastructure release. The workflow and license are directly documented; production-scale claims remain attributed to NVIDIA.
